title: Soorma Bhopali
overview: Soorma Bhopali is the owner of a Timber mart from whom people expect to purchase the wood of the entire jungle. Given that the jungle can't provide the wood, he wants to distribute all the wealth of humanity. This trust and innocence of his is taken advantage by the people. Dilwar Khan Dilwala, who happens to be the identical stepbrother of Soorma, keeps staking his claim on half of Soorma's inheritance. Soorma inherits a priceless necklace, which, according to his mother, he has to give it to his bride. To get this necklace from Soorma, some big-time smugglers send a stage dancer, Sitar to Bhopal and trap Soorma in their cleverly knitted web.
